acceptedAnswer.text: For new home plumbing installations in Goodyear and surrounding areas, several permits are typically required by the local building authority to ensure the work meets safety and code standards. These usually include a general building permit that covers various trades, but often a specific plumbing permit is also necessary. The permitting process ensures that the installation adheres to the Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC) and local amendments.
